problems: e3: bar ↔ pin-hole is not a compatible pair
notes: The four groups are not a mistake. I checked the manual again and kept them separate. The booklet builds separate models: the umbrella table on pages 3-5, the stool on page 6, the oven with cake on pages 7-10, and the sink on pages 11-12. The table, oven and sink each restart step numbering and each has its own preview box in the top corner. The stool is built from its own parts in step 5 and is shown as a loose piece beside the table. No step in the booklet joins one model to another. The page 13 picture shows them standing apart, so any connection between them would be invented.
The minifigure on page 2 (hair, head, torso, legs) is not in the PARTS LIST, so it is not included.

I could not see where all four black 1x1 round plates go. Reading the pictures, I put one on the oven box (b18) and two under the pink plates on the sink's round bricks (b37, b38). The fourth (b41) is a guess: I put it on the oven box too.
Stud and anti-stud ports are null wherever the exact stud position is not clear from the pictures.
The dish (b11) is shown on the bar's top end at step 4. I joined it to the bar's port bar.1.
The pink dish (b28) and the cake's grill brick (b24) are placed on the lime brick (b17). The dish has no ports, so I used contact edges for it.
The 2 x 2 round bricks (b1, b2, b12) are the Lime 3941 pieces. The stool has a white round tile (b13) on its top.
The tan plate (b21) sits on the door's studs with two pink plates and a brown tile on top.
